notes: This release fixes what happens when a posting is retried — after a failure, a crash, or a correction on screen. Each of these left a bank reconciliation that could never come out, and none of them showed anything wrong at the time. The cheque you actually wrote is now the cheque that gets registered: retrying after changing the cheque number used to register neither cheque (leaving the spoiled number outstanding for ever and the cheque handed over in no register at all) or both (one payment showing two cheques outstanding). The app now stops and names both numbers. A retry from a different bank is caught — the amount is unchanged, so the app used to reuse the first draft and credit one bank while the cheque was written on the other. And an entry now lands in the accounting period its own date falls in: with last year reopened for an audit adjustment, twenty-three screens were stamping work with the wrong period and the ledger refused it, with no way to correct it from any screen. Correcting a payment or receipt after a year end no longer dead-ends, and a correction lands in the same month as its reversal.
